EN.line: Simployer does the HR you shouldn’t have to.
EN.reason: So you can do the work you aspire to do.
EN.how: Sia does the work. HR experts stand behind you.
EN.howLong: Sia, your AI HR employee, does the work. HR experts have seen cases like yours.
EN.category: Not a faster HR system. The one that does it for you.
EN.trust: Nordic law built in. Real experts behind it.
EN.opener: The role grew. The work never left.

sia.name: Sia, your AI HR employee
sia.line: Your AI HR employee. Does the work and answers questions on the rules, with the source, where you already work.

experts.name: HR experts
experts.line: An HR expert by your side. Someone who’s seen cases like yours.

EN.automation: Your routines run on their own, so you don’t carry the process alone.

pillars.name: Leave the admin
pillars.head: The admin gets done, where you already work.
pillars.proof: Onboarding that starts when the contract is signed, leave approved in Teams, a contract sent for e-sign from an expert’s template.

pillars.name: Skip the worry
pillars.head: Get it right before you decide.
pillars.proof: A question on employment law answered with the source, an HR expert to talk a case through and share best practice, an offboarding workflow that reminds the right people.

pillars.name: Get the signal
pillars.head: Spot what’s changing, while there’s time to act.
pillars.proof: A reminder before a probation ends, the sick-leave trend when you ask Sia, a pay gap report and a legal update before the rules change.

foundation: Enter data once. Your routines run on it.
Law checked first, HR experts behind it.
story: The role grew. The work never left.
HR now carries culture, change and the hard conversations. The contracts, reminders and questions are all still there.
Finance, sales and support confirm. HR still stores, reminds and answers.
The work you aspire to do.
Everything that still leaves the work with you.
Systems store it. Assistants answer. You still do it.
Show one real task done, one law question answered with the source, an HR expert who’s seen cases like yours, and one customer who lives it.

rules: Lead with what gets done, not with who knows the most. Expertise is the trust line, never the headline.
Simployer is the actor in the line. Never “AI” on its own, never “a replacement”.
Sia and HR experts are the how: named as a pair wherever the whole offer is told, never the main line.
Introduce Sia once as “Sia, your AI HR employee”, then “Sia”. Always labelled as AI, never a face.
Call them “HR experts”. Never “real people”, “human experts” or “hard calls”.
Automation Studio is built in: use it as proof, never in the hero and never as a “workflow builder”.
“HR system” stays out of the hero. No named competitors.
Name the task, not the capability.
Present tense only for what has shipped. No figure finance hasn’t approved.

avoid.pattern: instead of your HR team|i stedet for HR-teamet|istället för HR-teamet
\breal people\b|\bhuman experts?\b|ekte mennesker|riktiga människor|menneskelige eksperter|mänskliga experter
avoid.why: Call them “HR experts”, never “real people” or “human experts”
Never “hard calls”: HR experts are for everyday and big questions alike
Simployer or Sia is the actor, never “AI” on its own
Name the task, not a broad claim
Automation Studio is never a “workflow builder”
Never name competitors in customer copy
Expertise is the trust line, never the headline

proofs.t: 12,000+ customers and 1.2 million users across the Nordics
Built for HR data: GDPR-ready, stored in the EU, covered by a data processing agreement
40 years of Nordic HR and employment law expertise
“With Simployer, I spend less time putting out fires and more time with my people.” Julia Amin, HR, Betao
“We use Simployer as a go-to partner when things get tricky.” Customer, Kaffebrenneriet
About 1,600 hours freed per year for a 115-person organisation, 4 to 8 month payback
